N2_note: N=2 not run separately; the prototype (commit 77a1a0a8) covers the 2x2 sign-flip case and the engine propagation is validated exhaustively at N=4 and N=8 (validate_soga_vs_mc.py).

fault_model.sites: 2*N^3 int32 accumulator FMA sites, uniform site + uniform bit 0..31

metric.rationale: eps=0 proved input-value-independent (degenerate); relative eps>0 exposes the v/norm dependence. The normalized shape is QUALITATIVELY consistent (always monotone decreasing) across eps but NOT exactly eps-invariant: normalized per-kernel susceptibility at max norm spans ~0.69-0.74 over eps in {1,4,16} (~5pp spread). See iter_1_finding.md.
metric.per_kernel: frac. injections changing ANY output cell
metric.per_cell: mean over injections of frac. output cells changed

methods.mc_register: EXACT enumeration over all (site,bit) injections (no sampling)
methods.soga: SOGA engine per-cell fault propagation; multipliers asserted == C[k][s]; aggregated over all sites with multiplicity; v-independent shifts reused across v-sweep

deviations_from_plan: eps=0 -> relative eps>0 (iter_1_finding.md): eps=0 gives degenerate flat/saturated SDC
metric pivoted from absolute MSK to normalized susceptibility-vs-norm SHAPE (user goal 2026-05-29)
exact enumeration replaces n=10^4 Monte Carlo (zero sampling noise)
v-grid expanded from {-1,0,1,6} to a 17-point norm sweep to trace the curve
33-class skipped; 65-class signed used directly (R7; sign irrelevant for |shift|>thr)
per-kernel computed exactly (any-cell-changes); union bound not used (R2 moot)
